question: A wholesaler marks his goods at 35% above the cost price but allows a discount of 15% at the time of sale. His gain is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = 135 % × Cost price (C.P)

Discount = 15%

**Formula used:**

M.P/C.P = (100 + P %)/(100 - D %)

Where, P = profit ; D = discount

**Calculation:**

M.P/C.P = (100 + P %)/(100 - D %)

⇒ 135/100 = (100 + P %)/(100 - 15)

⇒ (100 + P %)/85 = 135/100
